# The Realty Bazaar

> The Realty Bazaar is a real-estate property discovery platform and mobile-first PropTech workflow application for Indian property seekers and real estate brokers.

## Overview

The Realty Bazaar (https://therealtybazaar.com/) connects prospective property buyers and renters with independent real estate brokers across India. The platform operates on a two-part architecture:
- **Public Website**: A property discovery and browsing portal where consumers can search, view, and enquire about verified real estate listings without requiring an account.
- **Mobile Application**: A mobile app (available on Google Play and Apple App Store) where real estate brokers upload listings, generate AI property descriptions, syndicate media to Instagram and Facebook, manage paid advertising campaigns, and organize leads in a mobile CRM.

The website is primarily focused on public property discovery, browsing, and connecting consumers directly with listing brokers.

## How The Realty Bazaar Works

1. **Broker Listing Upload**: Licensed real estate brokers and channel partners upload property details, photos, and video walkthroughs exclusively through The Realty Bazaar mobile app.
2. **Public Web Availability**: When published in the app, property listings automatically appear on the public website (therealtybazaar.com) for organic search and buyer discovery.
3. **Property Discovery**: Property seekers browse, search, and filter available listings on the website with complete transparency and zero platform usage fees.
4. **Direct Communication**: Property seekers connect directly with the listing broker via phone call, WhatsApp chat, web enquiry, or by scheduling a physical site visit.
5. **Inbound Lead Routing**: Inquiries submitted through the website route instantly into the listing broker's mobile CRM for follow-up and deal management.

## For Property Seekers

Property seekers can perform the following on the website:
- Browse residential and commercial property listings freely without creating an account.
- Search and filter properties by city, locality, transaction type (Sale or Rent), property type, BHK layout, furnishing status, and budget.
- View detailed property specifications including price, price per square foot, super built-up area, carpet area, floor number, facing direction, furnishing, possession status, and amenities.
- Inspect high-resolution photo galleries and fullscreen image lightbox previews.
- Call the listing broker directly using the verified telephone number.
- Start a pre-filled WhatsApp conversation with the listing broker.
- Request a physical site visit by submitting preferred dates and time slots.
- Send a free online enquiry directly to the broker's mobile CRM.
- Share property details and copy structured property drafts across messaging apps and social platforms.

## For Brokers

- **Mobile-First Management**: Brokers upload, edit, and organize property listings exclusively from the mobile app on their phone.
- **AI Content Generation**: Automatically generate marketing copy, property descriptions, and relevant social media hashtags.
- **Social Media Syndication**: Publish property media directly to connected Instagram and Facebook accounts with one tap.
- **Paid Campaign Management**: Run managed Meta (Instagram/Facebook) and Google advertising campaigns with dedicated daily ad budgets.
- **Mobile CRM & Lead Tracking**: Consolidate leads from social media, paid ads, and website enquiries into a centralized mobile pipeline with follow-up reminders.
- **Broker Onboarding**: There is no separate broker registration or listing creation workflow on the website. Brokers join and manage inventory through the mobile app and verified broker portal (https://brokers.therealtybazaar.com).

## Property Listings

Property listings displayed on the website are provided directly by independent real estate brokers. Publicly visible listing fields include:
- **Title and Description**: Detailed overview and property title.
- **Transaction Type**: Listed for Sale or for Rent.
- **Property Category**: Apartment / Flat, Luxury Villa, Independent House, Plot / Land, Commercial Office, Retail Shop, Studio Apartment, or Penthouse.
- **Price**: Total listing price and price per square foot (for sale listings).
- **Location**: City, locality name, and street address.
- **Configuration & Dimensions**: Bedroom count (BHK), bathroom count, super built-up area, and carpet area in square feet.
- **Specifications**: Floor level, facing direction, furnishing status (Unfurnished, Semi-Furnished, Fully Furnished), possession status, and balcony count.
- **Amenities**: Verified amenities including 24/7 security, power backup, parking, elevator, clubhouse, gymnasium, swimming pool, and gardens.
- **Broker Details**: Broker name, brokerage agency name, and direct contact options.

## Key Features

- **Public Property Discovery**: Open catalogue of residential and commercial properties.
- **Multi-Parameter Search & Filters**: City, locality, price presets, BHK, property type, and furnishing filters.
- **Direct Broker Contact**: One-click Phone Call and WhatsApp chat buttons without middleman call centers.
- **Physical Site Visit Scheduling**: Date and time slot booking forms routed directly to listing brokers.
- **Share & Draft Text Generator**: Pre-formatted property draft summaries for WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, and Email sharing.
- **Social Media Publishing (App)**: Direct integration with Instagram and Facebook.
- **Managed Meta Advertising (App)**: Automated paid ad campaign management for verified local buyer leads.
- **Mobile Real Estate CRM (App)**: Contact management, follow-up notifications, and deal tracking.

## Advertising / Marketing

The Realty Bazaar offers broker-side marketing services described on the public website:
- **Social Media Syndication**: One-tap publishing of property media and AI captions to Instagram and Facebook.
- **Managed Paid Advertising**: For brokers on Growth Pro and High-Volume Elite plans, The Realty Bazaar manages targeted Meta Ads campaigns across Instagram and Facebook with dynamically optimized daily ad spend allocations (up to ₹350/day on Growth Pro and up to ₹500/day on High-Volume Elite).
- **Automatic Lead Capture**: Leads generated from paid advertising campaigns and social channels automatically land in the broker's mobile CRM.

## Pricing

The public website displays transparent subscription plans for real estate brokers:
- **Trial Plan**: ₹4,499 (one-time payment) — 30-day full access trial, up to 10 active property listings, full CRM, AI content generation, social publishing, and mobile app access.
- **Starter Broker**: ₹999 / month — Unlimited property uploads, integrated CRM and lead tracker, AI property descriptions, Instagram & Facebook publishing, verified website listings, and instant WhatsApp inquiry capture.
- **Growth Pro**: ₹14,999 / month — Everything in Starter, plus managed Meta & Google property ads, up to ₹350/day advertising allocation, campaign analytics, lead scoring, automated follow-up reminders, and dedicated account manager.
- **High-Volume Elite**: ₹19,999 / month — Everything in Growth Pro, plus up to ₹500/day advertising allocation, video content campaigns and reels, advanced AI property matching, priority WhatsApp and phone support, and custom branding on listing flyers.
- **Agency & Teams**: Custom pricing — Multi-broker and agent logins, custom advertising budget allocations, team performance dashboard, and dedicated agency account director.

*Consumer Pricing*: Browsing properties, viewing details, and contacting listing brokers is 100% free for property seekers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### For Property Seekers
- **Do I need an account to search or view properties?**
  No. Property seekers can browse all published listings and view complete property details without registering or creating an account.
- **Can I contact the listing broker directly?**
  Yes. Every property page includes direct Call and WhatsApp buttons connecting you to the verified listing broker.
- **Can I schedule a site visit?**
  Yes. Property seekers can request a physical site visit directly on the property page by selecting their preferred date and time slot.
- **Is there any charge for buyers or tenants to use the website?**
  No. Using the platform to discover properties and contact brokers is completely free.

### For Real Estate Brokers
- **Can brokers list properties directly on the website?**
  No. Brokers upload and manage their property inventory exclusively through The Realty Bazaar mobile application.
- **How do brokers join The Realty Bazaar?**
  Brokers download the mobile app from Google Play or Apple App Store, complete profile verification, and select a subscription plan via the verified broker portal (https://brokers.therealtybazaar.com).
- **How are leads delivered to brokers?**
  Inbound leads from website enquiries, site visit requests, WhatsApp interactions, and advertising campaigns land directly in the broker's mobile CRM with instant notifications.
